Keywords: Havel and Spree River Stone Castles
RagShortTexts: The Ascanian margraves carried the Red Eagle, transforming Brandenburg's Slavic forests.

Variants.Content: Bearing the soaring Red Eagle on argent, the House of Ascania established the Margraviate of Brandenburg. Descended from Albert the Bear, co-rulers John I and Otto III drove eastern colonization (Ostsiedlung) through marshes along the Spree and Havel, overseeing the rise of Berlin and Cölln.
Holding the hereditary imperial office of Arch-Chamberlain, Ascanian margraves commanded electoral status, pushing the Holy Roman Empire's northeastern border toward the Oder River.
Pioneer settlers arriving from Westphalia fell ancient oaks to ditch peat bogs, incentivized by Ascanian charters granting five years of exemption from feudal tithes.
